Author: Sandro
Name: NahjaUI
Punchline: A complete, modular interface for Final Fantasy XIV.
Description:
NahjaUI gives the game a clean, consistent interface that you build piece by piece. Switch on only what you want: everything else stays exactly as the game made it.

HUD bars: your parameter bar, target, target of target, focus target and party list.
Progress bars: your casts and your target's, with a slidecast marker, plus a global cooldown bar that shows the queue and weave windows.
Job gauges, status effects, nameplates and enmity list, each one with its own style.
Trackers: pick the enhancements, enfeeblements and cooldowns you want to see. Every job comes with ready-made presets.
Profiles: save, copy and share your whole setup.

Type /nui to open it.

Join the testers on Discord: https://nahjaui.github.io/discord
Changelog: New: bar gradient. The filled part of every bar and pip (unit frames, party and alliance lists, nameplates, enmity list, progress bars and job gauges) now goes from a slightly darker to a slightly lighter shade of its color; Appearance > Bar gradient (%) goes from 0 (flat) to 200. Warrior: new artwork for the Primal Rend, Primal Ruination and Primal Wrath auras, and the Primal Wrath arch now empties from the center to the sides. Layout: the space between pips and between tracker icons can be set to -1 to overlap exactly one border, so neighbours share one line. Rows of pips are now exactly as wide as a bar of the same size, and when the width does not divide evenly the extra pixels go to the middle pip. Gauge numbers are always drawn above every gauge. Defaults: Sprint is shown only while it is on you or on cooldown. Non-interruptible casts use the exact accent color of the plugin and the slidecast marker is blue. Fixes: auras and trackers no longer flash as expired for a moment when a status has just been applied. Peloton was duplicated in the default trackers and when importing the preset of some jobs.
